find_files_recursively: recursively find all .urdf files under a directory using a discriminator function
file_endswith_check: check if a file path ends with a given string like .urdf

get_humanoid_models: get a list of humanoid URDF and motion data file pairs from a directory
switch_avatar_model: switch the active humanoid avatar to the next model preserving position and orientation
